title: Reflected Context
brief: A search page writes the decoded query into an HTML response without context-aware encoding.
submission: reflected input crosses into markup context

title: Stored Context
brief: A synthetic profile renderer combines stored display data with an interpreting DOM sink.
submission: stored profile data reaches an interpreting browser sink

title: Borrowed Authority
brief: A preference endpoint accepts an ambient session from a foreign origin without a request-bound token.
submission: state change accepts ambient session without csrf binding

title: Origin Mirror
brief: A credentialed profile response reflects any Origin value ending in a misleading suffix.
submission: credentialed cors decision trusts an attacker controlled origin

title: Query Fracture
brief: A catalog query concatenates a category into SQL instead of binding a typed value.
submission: catalog filter is interpreted as sql structure

title: Operator Drift
brief: A JSON lookup passes a caller-controlled object directly into a document query.
submission: json operator changes the nosql match predicate

title: Argument Break
brief: A diagnostic wrapper assembles caller input into shell source rather than a fixed argument vector.
submission: diagnostic input crosses into shell grammar

title: Root Escape
brief: A file service joins a decoded name to its content root without verifying the final canonical path.
submission: decoded path escapes the intended content root

title: False Image
brief: An upload service trusts filename and declared media type without decoding the supplied content.
submission: upload pipeline trusts caller metadata instead of content

title: Entity Window
brief: An XML importer resolves a designated local external entity during document processing.
submission: xml parser resolves a local external entity

title: Template Pulse
brief: A welcome renderer compiles the caller-provided name as template source.
submission: caller input is evaluated as template source

title: Type Confusion
brief: A polymorphic object endpoint lets a caller select a class with an unexpected side effect.
submission: caller controlled type selects an unapproved object variant

title: Internal Fetch
brief: A server-side fetcher accepts arbitrary HTTP destinations and can reach an internal synthetic canary.
submission: fetcher reaches an internal destination selected by the caller

title: Session Afterlife
brief: A recovery transition advances password state but leaves the designated old session authorized.
submission: password recovery fails to revoke the old session

title: Foreign Order
brief: An order API authenticates the caller but does not enforce tenant ownership on object reads.
submission: tenant a identity reads the designated tenant b object

title: Algorithm Trust
brief: A token verifier derives its verification mode from the untrusted JWT header.
submission: jwt verifier accepts a caller selected algorithm mode

title: Redirect Drift
brief: An authorization endpoint validates redirect URIs with prefix matching instead of exact registration.
submission: oauth authorization accepts an attacker controlled redirect prefix

title: Hidden Field
brief: A GraphQL endpoint protects the page but not a sensitive field resolver.
submission: low privilege graphql query resolves a protected field

title: Double Spend
brief: A single-use coupon check and mutation are separated, allowing two synchronized requests to commit.
submission: concurrent requests violate the single use invariant

title: Split Stream
brief: A front parser and back parser disagree about the boundary of one supplied synthetic request stream.
submission: adjacent http parsers disagree about request boundaries

title: Unkeyed Host
brief: A cached homepage varies on forwarded host metadata that is absent from the cache key.
submission: unkeyed host input changes a cacheable response

title: Report Furnace
brief: A report endpoint allocates work from caller-controlled rows and expansion depth before enforcing a budget.
submission: one api request bypasses operation cost controls
